findings.issue: Borderline with the guideline's HTL ONLY 'Reagents: chemistry principles/theories' (formaldehyde oxidizing to formic acid, sodium iodate ripening, sulfurous acid decolorizing basic fuchsin, oil red O solubility, metachromasia). Each can also be read as reagent 'types/components' or 'properties/functions/actions', which the HT exam does cover, so I would keep them.
Asks why cleared tissue looks translucent (refractive indices matched). Refractive index is HTL ONLY only under Mounting Procedures; this is a clearing property, so it is in HT scope.
IHC items stay on terminology (DAB, epitope), counterstain and CLIA QC frequency; none asks staining theory, antigen retrieval, control selection or detection theory (HTL ONLY).
